name: app-shater-craftsman-app-sitemap-tree-from-hand-held-phone
title: Shater craftsman app sitemap: five modules branching from a hand-held phone with a '90 screens' claim
whatItIs: A light page with a big orange-and-navy 'تطبيق الحرفي' (Craftsman App) title numbered 02, a hand holding a phone showing the dashboard, five module pills (Account, Conversations, Orders, Services, Home) each linked down by dotted lines to a phone screen and a caption, closing with '+90 screens'.
whatItMeans: Systematic and reassuring; branching from one hero phone to five modules maps the whole app clearly.
techniques: Branch a sitemap from a single hero device.
Number each app in a multi-app platform.
Caption each screen with its sub-features.

vocabulary.definition: A diagram of an app or site's screens and structure.
A distinct functional section of an app.
